title: Cloud-bank softness
duration_policy: shortest actually supported; API minimum 1s verified 2026-09-16, website minimum not assumed
must_move: only the soft interior wisps within the cloud bank drift almost imperceptibly
must_not_move: mountain silhouettes, tree islands, outer cloud bank silhouette, garden and camera
end_state: the cloud bank keeps its original shape and nearly its original interior pattern
negative_constraints: no boiling fog, expanding cloud mass, hidden mountain peaks, gray smoke or camera movement
runtime_contract: Optional subtle local masked interior flow; if it reads as boiling or costs too much overdraw keep clouds static. Lower priority than water and plants.
first_frame_review: DRAFT: candidate painting and crop unaccepted
interface_contract: Single-image I2V uploads IMAGE_1 only; IMAGE_2 is operator reference unless selected multi-reference interface demonstrably preserves first-frame lock. Preserve input aspect; do not force 16:9. Request lowest sufficient supported resolution; returned native size/fps recorded separately.
requested_resolution: 480p initial motion study; actual returned dimensions must be recorded
